BETA Close X RS Group plc has purchased 185,968 of its ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme, with transactions occurring between September 7th and September 11th, 2026, at prices ranging from 723.50 pence to 767.50 pence per share. Following these purchases, the company's total issued ordinary shares will be 469,195,428, with no shares held in treasury, resulting in a total of 469,195,428 voting rights. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 14 September 2026 RS Group plc 14 September 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 7 September 2026 to 11 September 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange.
